name: Robotphoenix Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Robotphoenix Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. was established in Taizhou, China, in 2012 and supplies industrial robots and automation solutions worldwide. Its robot lines include Bat parallel robots, Python Scara robots, Mantis six-axis robots, Camel AGV robots and Lobster wafer handling robots, supported by the Gorilla series.
